purpose: Verify that Dean-RSPC forwards a request whose represented approval path requires Director action to the Director stage instead of finalizing it.
preconditions: An eligible research project proposal has passed HoD and RSPC Admin stages and is pending at the Dean-RSPC stage; the represented approval path for this proposal requires Director action. Dean-RSPC user is authenticated.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC records a favourable decision / forwards the proposal.
expected_result: The proposal moves to the Director stage and is pending Director action; it is not recorded as finally approved at Dean-RSPC.

source_id: BR-RSPC-005 permitted (Director records approval of large funding request)
purpose: Verify that the Director can record the required final approval for a large funding request at the Director stage.
preconditions: A large funding request meeting the represented Director-approval condition is pending at the Director stage. Director user is authenticated.
action_or_input: Director records approval of the request.
expected_result: The approval is accepted and recorded as the Director's final approval; the request is shown as approved.

purpose: Verify that a user without the Director role cannot record the required Director approval for a large funding request.
preconditions: A large funding request meeting the represented Director-approval condition is pending at the Director stage. A Dean-RSPC user (not Director) is authenticated.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC user attempts to record the final approval at the Director stage.
expected_result: The action is rejected as unauthorized; the request remains pending at the Director stage and is not marked approved.

purpose: Verify that the Director can record the required authorization for a high-value expenditure request at the Director stage.
preconditions: A high-value expenditure request meeting the represented Director-authorization condition is pending at the Director stage. Director user is authenticated.
action_or_input: Director records authorization of the expenditure request.
expected_result: The authorization is accepted and recorded; the expenditure request is shown as authorized/approved.

purpose: Verify that a user without the Director role cannot record the required Director authorization for a high-value expenditure.
preconditions: A high-value expenditure request meeting the represented Director-authorization condition is pending at the Director stage. An RSPC Admin or Dean-RSPC user (not Director) is authenticated.
action_or_input: The non-Director user attempts to record authorization at the Director stage.
expected_result: The action is rejected as unauthorized; the expenditure request remains pending at the Director stage and is not authorized.

source_id: BR-RSPC-012 route with Director applicable; BR-RSPC-069 condition-true
purpose: Verify that a research proposal requiring the Director stage advances in order Faculty -> HoD -> RSPC Admin -> Dean-RSPC -> Director.
preconditions: Faculty, HoD, RSPC Admin, Dean-RSPC and Director users exist with their RSPC roles; the proposal meets the represented Director-routing condition.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a complete proposal; HoD recommends/forwards; RSPC Admin verifies as eligible and forwards; Dean-RSPC forwards; Director approves.
expected_result: After each action the proposal is at the next stated stage (HoD, then RSPC Admin, then Dean-RSPC, then Director); after the Director decision the proposal is approved. No stage is skipped.

source_id: BR-RSPC-012 stated exception (Director stage not applicable); BR-RSPC-069 condition-false; BR-RSPC-068 permitted
purpose: Verify that a research proposal for which the Director stage is not applicable is finalized at Dean-RSPC without entering the Director stage.
preconditions: A proposal that does not meet the represented Director-routing condition has passed HoD and RSPC Admin (eligible) and is pending at Dean-RSPC; it is within Dean-RSPC's represented authority.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC approves the proposal.
expected_result: The proposal is recorded as approved at Dean-RSPC and never enters the Director stage.

purpose: Verify that a later-stage approver cannot act on a proposal that has not yet reached that stage.
preconditions: A Faculty proposal has just been submitted and is pending at the HoD stage. Dean-RSPC user is authenticated.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC attempts to approve/forward the proposal while it is still at the HoD stage.
expected_result: The action is rejected; the proposal remains at the HoD stage and its status is unchanged.

purpose: Verify that a proposal with all mandatory fields is accepted as submitted and advances.
preconditions: Faculty user is authenticated.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a proposal with objectives, timelines, budget, funding source and resource requirements all provided.
expected_result: Submission succeeds; the proposal is recorded as submitted and advances to the HoD review stage.

purpose: Verify that a proposal is not advanced as submitted when any of the mandatory fields named in the PS is incomplete.
preconditions: Faculty user is authenticated.
action_or_input: For each mandatory field in turn (objectives, timelines, budget, funding source, resource requirements), Faculty submits an otherwise complete proposal with that field missing/blank.
expected_result: Each submission is rejected with a validation error identifying the incomplete field; no proposal is recorded as submitted or advanced to HoD.

source_id: BR-RSPC-014 represented validation fails; BR-RSPC-070 represented policy applied
purpose: Verify that a represented/configured proposal policy validation prevents advancement of a proposal that violates it.
preconditions: A proposal policy validation is explicitly represented/configured in RSPC (e.g. a configured limit on a proposal attribute). Faculty user is authenticated.
action_or_input: Faculty submits an otherwise complete proposal that violates the represented policy validation.
expected_result: The proposal is not advanced; a validation error referencing the policy is returned.

purpose: Verify that a proposal satisfying the represented policy validation advances normally.
preconditions: The same represented/configured proposal policy validation as BR-011 exists. Faculty user is authenticated.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a complete proposal that satisfies the represented policy validation.
expected_result: The proposal is accepted as submitted and advances to the HoD stage.

purpose: Verify that every recorded research-proposal review/approval decision carries a timestamp.
preconditions: A submitted proposal; HoD, RSPC Admin, Dean-RSPC users exist.
action_or_input: HoD, RSPC Admin and Dean-RSPC each record their decision on the proposal; then retrieve the proposal's decision/approval history.
expected_result: Each decision record in the history includes a non-empty timestamp corresponding to when the decision was recorded.

purpose: Verify that every recorded research-proposal review/approval decision retains the remarks entered with it.
preconditions: A submitted proposal; HoD, RSPC Admin, Dean-RSPC users exist.
action_or_input: HoD, RSPC Admin and Dean-RSPC each record their decision with distinct remarks text; then retrieve the decision/approval history.
expected_result: Each decision record includes exactly the remarks entered by that reviewer.

source_id: BR-RSPC-022 HoD and Director stages applicable
purpose: Verify that a consultancy record whose represented path includes HoD and Director passes through those stages.
preconditions: The represented institutional path for the consultancy makes the HoD and Director stages applicable. Faculty and approver users exist.
action_or_input: Faculty submits the consultancy record; each applicable approver acts in turn.
expected_result: The consultancy passes through the HoD stage and the Director stage as part of its approval; it is approved only after the Director stage.

source_id: BR-RSPC-022 stated exception (HoD and Director stages not applicable)
purpose: Verify that a consultancy record is routed only through represented applicable stages, skipping HoD and Director when they are not applicable.
preconditions: The represented institutional path for the consultancy does not make the HoD or Director stages applicable.
action_or_input: Faculty submits the consultancy record; the applicable approvers act.
expected_result: The consultancy never enters the HoD or Director stage and is finalized at the last applicable stage.

purpose: Verify that an eligible staff-appointment request is routed to Dean-RSPC and finalized there when Director is not applicable.
preconditions: An eligible project staff-appointment request has reached the approval phase; the represented appointment path does not make Director applicable.
action_or_input: The request reaches the approval phase; Dean-RSPC approves.
expected_result: The request is routed to Dean-RSPC and recorded as approved there without entering the Director stage.

purpose: Verify that an eligible staff-appointment request is routed through Dean-RSPC and then Director when Director is applicable.
preconditions: An eligible project staff-appointment request has reached the approval phase; the represented appointment path makes Director applicable.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC acts on the request, then Director approves.
expected_result: The request is routed to Dean-RSPC, then to Director, and is approved only after the Director decision.

source_id: BR-RSPC-032 within delegated powers; BR-RSPC-033 condition-false
purpose: Verify that a verified financial request within Dean-RSPC's represented delegated powers can be approved at Dean-RSPC and is not escalated.
preconditions: Delegated financial powers for Dean-RSPC are represented/configured; a verified fund-utilization/expenditure request with amount within the delegated limit is at Dean-RSPC.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC approves the request.
expected_result: The request is recorded as approved at Dean-RSPC and is not routed to Director.

source_id: BR-RSPC-032 beyond delegated powers; BR-RSPC-033 condition-true
purpose: Verify that a verified financial request beyond Dean-RSPC's delegated powers is not approved at Dean-RSPC and is escalated to Director.
preconditions: Delegated financial powers for Dean-RSPC are represented/configured; a verified request with amount exceeding the delegated limit (meeting the Director-escalation condition) is at Dean-RSPC.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC attempts to approve the request / the request is processed at Dean-RSPC.
expected_result: Dean-RSPC approval is not recorded as final; the request is routed to the Director stage.

purpose: Verify that financial request, verification, approval, escalation and transaction-record events are logged for audit.
preconditions: Faculty, RSPC Admin, Dean-RSPC and Director users exist; delegated limits represented such that the request escalates.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a financial request; RSPC Admin verifies it; it is escalated to Director; Director approves; a transaction record is recorded. Then retrieve the audit/reporting record.
expected_result: The audit record contains one entry for each lifecycle event (request, verification, escalation, approval, transaction record) with actor and time.

purpose: Verify that a procurement request within the sanctioned project budget is advanced as eligible.
preconditions: A project with a sanctioned budget represented in RSPC; Faculty is the project owner.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a procurement request whose cost is within the remaining sanctioned budget.
expected_result: The request passes budget validation and is advanced as eligible to approval.

purpose: Verify that a procurement request exceeding the sanctioned project budget is not advanced as eligible.
preconditions: A project with a sanctioned budget represented in RSPC; Faculty is the project owner.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a procurement request whose cost exceeds the remaining sanctioned budget.
expected_result: The request fails budget validation and is not advanced as eligible; a validation message is returned.

purpose: Verify that an eligible procurement request is routed through the represented approval stages in order.
preconditions: An eligible procurement request; a represented procurement approval hierarchy; approver users exist.
action_or_input: Each applicable approver in the represented hierarchy acts in order.
expected_result: The request moves through exactly the represented stages in order and is approved after the final applicable stage.

purpose: Verify that a procurement request cannot be approved by an approver outside its current applicable stage.
preconditions: An eligible procurement request pending at the first applicable approval stage.
action_or_input: An approver of a later stage (e.g. Director) attempts to approve the request before earlier stages are complete.
expected_result: The action is rejected; the request remains at its current stage.

purpose: Verify that a report becomes due/pending and a reminder is raised according to the represented reporting schedule.
preconditions: A project with a represented reporting schedule whose next report due date has been reached; no report submitted for that period.
action_or_input: Evaluate the project's report status / run the reminder processing.
expected_result: The report for the period is shown as due/pending and a reminder notification is generated for the responsible Faculty.

source_id: BR-RSPC-037 schedule due date not reached
purpose: Verify that no due/pending status or reminder is generated before the represented schedule's due date.
preconditions: A project with a represented reporting schedule whose next due date is in the future.
action_or_input: Evaluate the project's report status / run the reminder processing.
expected_result: No report is shown as pending/overdue for that period and no reminder is generated.

purpose: Verify that an authorized actor can access historical progress reports throughout the project lifecycle.
preconditions: A project owned by Faculty A with several submitted progress reports, including after the project has advanced to a later lifecycle state (e.g. closed).
action_or_input: Faculty A requests the project's historical progress reports.
expected_result: All historical progress reports of the project are returned.

purpose: Verify that an actor outside the authorized role/project scope cannot access historical progress reports.
preconditions: A project owned by Faculty A with submitted progress reports; Faculty B has no role on the project.
action_or_input: Faculty B requests the project's historical progress reports.
expected_result: Access is denied (or no reports of that project are returned).

purpose: Verify that an authorized actor can access historical utilization reports throughout the project lifecycle.
preconditions: A project owned by Faculty A with several submitted utilization reports, including after the project has advanced to a later lifecycle state.
action_or_input: Faculty A requests the project's historical utilization reports.
expected_result: All historical utilization reports of the project are returned.

purpose: Verify that an actor outside the authorized role/project scope cannot access historical utilization reports.
preconditions: A project owned by Faculty A with submitted utilization reports; Faculty B has no role on the project.
action_or_input: Faculty B requests the project's historical utilization reports.
expected_result: Access is denied (or no reports of that project are returned).

purpose: Verify that a completed project whose closure is approved is archived as closed with its audit trail retained.
preconditions: A completed project with a prior audit trail and a submitted closure record pending final closure approval.
action_or_input: The applicable approver records closure approval.
expected_result: The project is shown as archived/closed and its complete RSPC audit trail remains retrievable.

purpose: Verify that a project is not archived when closure approval has not been recorded.
preconditions: A completed project with a submitted closure record still pending approval (or rejected).
action_or_input: Retrieve the project's status without closure approval being recorded.
expected_result: The project is not archived/closed.

purpose: Verify that information supplied through an explicitly configured integration is processed as RSPC integration data.
preconditions: An integration source is explicitly represented/configured for RSPC.
action_or_input: The configured integration supplies RSPC-relevant information.
expected_result: The information is accepted and recorded in RSPC.

purpose: Verify that information from an integration not configured for RSPC is not processed.
preconditions: An integration source that is not represented/configured for RSPC.
action_or_input: The unconfigured source supplies RSPC-relevant information.
expected_result: The information is rejected/ignored and no RSPC record is created or changed.

purpose: Verify that a user can view RSPC project data within their authorized role and record scope.
preconditions: Faculty A owns proposal P-A.
action_or_input: Faculty A requests the list of proposals and the details of P-A.
expected_result: P-A is included in the list and its details are returned.

purpose: Verify that a user cannot view RSPC data outside their authorized role and record scope.
preconditions: Faculty A owns proposal P-A; Faculty B has only the Faculty role and no relation to P-A.
action_or_input: Faculty B requests the list of proposals and the details of P-A.
expected_result: P-A is not included in Faculty B's list and the detail request is denied (or reports not found).

purpose: Verify that a user can perform an RSPC action allowed by their assigned role.
preconditions: A proposal pending at the HoD stage; user with the HoD role for the department.
action_or_input: HoD records a recommendation on the proposal.
expected_result: The action is accepted and the decision is recorded.

purpose: Verify that a user cannot perform an RSPC action not allowed by their assigned role.
preconditions: A proposal pending at the HoD stage; a user holding only the Faculty role.
action_or_input: The Faculty user attempts to record the HoD decision on the proposal.
expected_result: The action is blocked as unauthorized; the proposal and its decision history are unchanged.

purpose: Verify that auditable RSPC events/record changes are retained in the RSPC audit log.
preconditions: Faculty and reviewer users exist.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a proposal and a reviewer records a decision; retrieve the RSPC audit/history log for the proposal.
expected_result: The log contains entries for the submission and the decision, each identifying the actor, action and time.

purpose: Verify that a role assignment supplied through the authorized Fusion role-management mechanism is applied to RSPC access.
preconditions: A user without any RSPC role.
action_or_input: Assign the HoD RSPC role to the user through the authorized Fusion role-management mechanism; the user then attempts an HoD action.
expected_result: The assignment is applied; the user is permitted to perform the HoD action.

purpose: Verify that role-assignment information not supplied through the authorized mechanism is not applied.
preconditions: A user holding only the Faculty role.
action_or_input: Supply role-assignment information outside the authorized mechanism (e.g. the user attempts to assign themselves the Dean-RSPC role through an RSPC request), then attempt a Dean-RSPC action.
expected_result: The assignment is not applied; the Dean-RSPC action is blocked.

purpose: Verify that a role reassignment supplied through the authorized mechanism is applied to RSPC access.
preconditions: User U holds the HoD RSPC role; user V holds no HoD role.
action_or_input: Reassign the HoD role from U to V through the authorized Fusion role-management mechanism; V attempts an HoD action.
expected_result: The reassignment is applied; V is permitted to perform the HoD action.

purpose: Verify that role-reassignment information not supplied through the authorized mechanism is not applied.
preconditions: User U holds the HoD RSPC role; user V holds only the Faculty role.
action_or_input: Supply reassignment information outside the authorized mechanism (e.g. V or U attempts to transfer the HoD role through an RSPC request), then V attempts an HoD action.
expected_result: The reassignment is not applied; V's HoD action is blocked and U retains HoD access.

purpose: Verify that an authorized role change takes effect immediately for RSPC access (new access granted, old access withdrawn).
preconditions: User U holds the HoD role and can perform HoD actions; a proposal is pending at the HoD stage.
action_or_input: Through the authorized mechanism, remove U's HoD role and grant it to V; immediately (no re-login or delay) U and V each attempt the HoD action.
expected_result: U's attempt is blocked and V's attempt is permitted, without any waiting period.

purpose: Verify that RSPC processing of staff-appointment information is limited to records/status and does not execute HR or payroll actions.
preconditions: An approved project staff appointment with stipend information.
action_or_input: Record a stipend/payment-related status update for the appointment in RSPC.
expected_result: RSPC stores the status/record only; no HR master-data change or payroll/payment execution is performed by RSPC.

purpose: Verify that RSPC processing of financial/settlement information is limited to request, approval, status and transaction records without accounting or bank-payment execution.
preconditions: An approved financial request.
action_or_input: Record a transaction/settlement record for the request in RSPC.
expected_result: RSPC stores the transaction/status record only; no ledger posting, bank payment or disbursement execution is performed by RSPC.

purpose: Verify that RSPC processing of procurement or asset-declaration information is limited to request/validation/approval/status records.
preconditions: An approved procurement request.
action_or_input: Record a procurement status update / asset declaration in RSPC.
expected_result: RSPC stores the status/asset record only; no purchase order, vendor or stock-master operation is executed by RSPC.

purpose: Verify that an RSPC notification event is recorded/triggered through the represented Fusion channels.
preconditions: Faculty and HoD users exist.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a proposal (a notification-triggering RSPC event).
expected_result: A notification event for the responsible reviewer is recorded/triggered through the Fusion dashboard (and email) channel.

purpose: Verify that a failure of the external email-delivery infrastructure does not affect the RSPC action or expand RSPC behaviour.
preconditions: The platform email-delivery service is unavailable / raises a delivery failure.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a proposal (a notification-triggering RSPC event).
expected_result: The RSPC submission still succeeds and the RSPC notification event is recorded; RSPC does not fail the action because of the external delivery failure.

purpose: Verify that RSPC only stores/tracks represented external funding-agency information and does not execute the external agency process.
preconditions: A project with a represented external funding-agency submission/disbursement tracking field.
action_or_input: Record an external funding-agency submission or disbursement status in RSPC.
expected_result: The status is stored as tracking information only; no external agency submission or disbursement is executed by RSPC.

purpose: Verify that RSPC consumes Fusion authentication/role information and enforces it without administering platform identity.
preconditions: RSPC endpoints are available.
action_or_input: Send an unauthenticated request to an RSPC data endpoint.
expected_result: The request is rejected as unauthenticated by the Fusion authentication mechanism; no RSPC data is returned.

source_id: BR-RSPC-065 update permitted in current lifecycle state
purpose: Verify that Faculty can update project details when the current lifecycle state permits the update.
preconditions: Faculty A owns a proposal/project in a lifecycle state that permits editing (e.g. draft / returned for revision).
action_or_input: Faculty A updates the project details.
expected_result: The update is saved and the new values are returned.

source_id: BR-RSPC-065 update not permitted in current lifecycle state
purpose: Verify that Faculty cannot update project details when the current lifecycle state does not permit the update.
preconditions: Faculty A owns a proposal/project in a lifecycle state that does not permit editing (e.g. submitted and under review, or closed).
action_or_input: Faculty A attempts to update the project details.
expected_result: The update is rejected; stored values are unchanged.

purpose: Verify that RSPC Admin forwards a request to the next approving authority when verification is eligible.
preconditions: A proposal recommended by HoD and pending RSPC Admin verification.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin records an eligible verification outcome and forwards.
expected_result: The request advances to the Dean-RSPC stage.

purpose: Verify that a request with an ineligible verification outcome does not advance as eligible.
preconditions: A proposal recommended by HoD and pending RSPC Admin verification.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin records an ineligible (incomplete/non-compliant) verification outcome.
expected_result: The request does not advance to the Dean-RSPC stage; it is not shown as eligible.

purpose: Verify that HoD forwards a request to the next stage when the departmental recommendation is recorded as recommended.
preconditions: A submitted proposal pending at the HoD stage.
action_or_input: HoD records the recommendation as recommended.
expected_result: The recommendation is recorded and the request advances to the RSPC Admin stage.

purpose: Verify that a non-recommended request is recorded without being forwarded as recommended.
preconditions: A submitted proposal pending at the HoD stage.
action_or_input: HoD records the recommendation as not recommended.
expected_result: The non-recommendation is recorded in the decision history; the request does not advance to the RSPC Admin stage as recommended.

source_id: BR-RSPC-068 outside authority (forward/escalate); BR-RSPC-004 Dean does not finalize
purpose: Verify that Dean-RSPC cannot record final approval of an eligible request outside its represented authority; the forwarding/escalation path applies.
preconditions: An eligible request at Dean-RSPC whose represented path requires Director action (outside Dean-RSPC authority).
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC attempts to record final approval of the request.
expected_result: Final approval at Dean-RSPC is not recorded; the request is forwarded/escalated to the Director stage (or remains pending) and is not shown as approved.

purpose: Verify that Dean-RSPC cannot approve a request that has not been routed to Dean-RSPC as eligible.
preconditions: A request whose RSPC Admin verification outcome is ineligible (or not yet verified).
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC attempts to approve the request.
expected_result: The approval is rejected; the request is not marked approved.

source_id: BR-RSPC-070 unrepresented external policy not invented
purpose: Verify that an external policy/threshold that is not represented/configured in RSPC does not alter RSPC behaviour.
preconditions: No proposal policy validation and no Director-escalation threshold is represented/configured in RSPC.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a complete proposal with a large budget value and it is processed by the reviewers.
expected_result: The proposal is processed on the stated route without any validation failure or Director escalation attributed to an unrepresented external policy value.
